scope: Local independent analysis and production-API verification; no Cloud interaction performed by this audit.

independent_review.html_structure: Body paragraph alone; unsupported elements, missing closes, duplicate structural elements and misplaced metadata rejected in targeted probes.
independent_review.whitespace: Fresh exports preserve leading/trailing ordinary spaces, empty lines and final LF; rt layout br joins while body br plus generated LF represents one newline.
independent_review.entity_handling: Escaped literal ruby markup, nested amp strings and numeric reference spellings survive one decode without second interpretation.
independent_review.stale_download_static_review: Input method, source and ruby direction included in identity; input callbacks clear result; identity checked before showing download.
independent_review.plain_route: Existing definitions except main and all original main statements preserved structurally and in order; old dictionary and conversion algorithms unchanged.

limitations: Residual corpus covers JA kanji actual fragments, not arbitrary sentences or all language-specific annotation dictionaries.
Each inverse module processes 11677 residual fragments and 60 whole export fixtures; these are finite tests, not a guarantee for arbitrary edited HTML.
The 12 Cloud downloads are historical saved files re-read locally, not a fresh browser run.
Wrong direction or plausible edited readings may be structurally indistinguishable; the caller must explicitly choose the original ruby format.
Source spelling prior to circumflex normalization and consumed @/% markers are not restored.
